phishing_scenarios.title: Lookalike Brand & Urgent Credential Theft
phishing_scenarios.text: CRITICAL ALERT: Your Microsoft 365 enterprise account will be suspended within 24 hours due to unverified sign-in attempts. Click immediately to restore access and verify your password.

phishing_scenarios.title: IP-Hosted Payment Form Phish
phishing_scenarios.text: Your recent invoice #INV-92144 is overdue. Please remit payment via our encrypted portal linked below to prevent legal debt recovery.

phishing_scenarios.title: Benign Corporate IT Announcement
phishing_scenarios.text: Team, please note that quarterly maintenance will take place this Saturday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM EST. Access to internal wiki will be temporarily read-only.

impersonation_scenarios.title: CEO Urgent Wire Transfer (BEC)
impersonation_scenarios.content: Are you at your desk? I need an urgent and confidential wire transfer processed today for our vendor acquisition before market close. Wire instructions are attached.

impersonation_scenarios.title: Synthetic Audio Deepfake Verification
impersonation_scenarios.content: I am sending you an audio voice memo authorizing the transfer request since I am boarding a flight.

impersonation_scenarios.title: Legitimate Executive Announcement
impersonation_scenarios.content: Good morning team, please find attached the revised Q3 sprint goals discussed during yesterday's all-hands meeting.
